svg.title: Forest Service / BC / Airtanker Operations
svg.desc: Clean geometry is interpreted from the supplied source; it is not an authenticated production master. Replacement outlined fonts approximate stitched/painted lettering; camera perspective, stitch texture and uncertain fine detail are not reproduced. Colors are selected from visual reference, without color calibration. This is a painted aircraft emblem, not a cloth patch. Rivets, scratches and aircraft panel reflections are omitted. Wing proportions and feather-line counts follow the photographed marking, rather than the generic repo wing proportions.
